newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Office buys 49 pct of Dudley of UK.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Office buys 49 pct of Dudley of UK.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co said on Monday that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire a 49 percent ownership stake in Dudley Stationery Ltd of Britain.
Under the agreement, U.S. Office will invest about $79 million in Dudley over a two-year period. In addition, Dudley plans to raise 50 million pounds in debt financing, U.S. Office said.
Further terms of the deal were not disclosed. U.S. Office said the deal should close in November.
Dudley is Britain' largest independent office products dealer with more than $110 million in annual sales, U.S. Office said.
U.S. Office said it has completed 113 acquisitions with current annualized sales of about $2.5 billion.
